name: Cogen Bologna
summary: This application offers a virtual reality tour inside the Cogen plant of Hera. The district heating system, located in the city of Bologna, provides hot water and electricity to 8000 homes. The conditions of the machines and the measurements displayed within the application are provided in real time directly from the plant itself.
